name: youtube-tracklist-to-spotify
description: Firefox extension that detects YouTube tracklists and adds tracks to Spotify playlists.

scripts.lint: npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist
scripts.start: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist
scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --overwrite-dest
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint
